title: ISO 230-2:2014 — Test code for machine tools — Part 2: Determination of accuracy and repeatability of positioning of numerically controlled axes
version: Edition 4, 2014-05; Amendment 1:2016 (https://www.iso.org/standard/63976.html); ISO catalogue last reviewed and confirmed 2025; accessed 2026-11-25.
locator: Official catalogue abstract and lifecycle status; direct measurement of individual linear or rotary numerically controlled axes.
notes: Official catalogue confirms ISO 230-2:2014 was reviewed and confirmed in 2025; Amendment 1:2016 is a separate published amendment. The method concerns positioning accuracy and repeatability of individual axes; it is not a simultaneous multi-axis test and does not create universal post-repair release limits.
